native_results: Both GPUs: five scenarios pixel-identical, sync errors 0. Direct source generation removes four-vertex packing; metadata classification uses CPU local value, never a read from mapped upload output. Not a full-game/native UI integration.
present_copy_results: Both GPUs: four scenarios including background-only, pixel-identical, sync errors 0. A includes extra identity fullscreen SDR sample pass and B omits it. Output image is compared; not merely comparing the unchanged source scene. Offscreen, 1333x600; no WSI, screen scaling, HDR or compute scaling coverage.
production_decision: Native-instance and presentation experiments not promoted. Ordinary uint16 production path remains.
timing_scope: Only Temp; GPU timestamps and partial CPU recording wall time. No formal performance ledger numbers. First native prototype read mapped upload memory for pipeline classification and had pathological host cost; corrected local-value variant is reported separately.
